
	<div class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/XiaovHei/p/20607879" title="发布于 2026-06-18 10:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Burp Suite+MCP+DeepSeek</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	
	<div class="postText">
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>工具准备：</p>
<p>1、Burp Suite v2025+（版本若较低可查看扩展商店中是否支持下载MCP server这个插件）</p>
<p>2、Cherry Studio</p>
<p>3、一条能用的API key&nbsp;</p>
<p>这里咱使用的是Burp Suite v2026<br><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260617172535309-949559863.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>API咱使用的是<a href="https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys</a><br><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260617172628123-1125538198.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>  首先在平台中选中自己API的厂商，填入厂商提供的API密钥。（如下图）</p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260617172958565-1550477848.png" class="lazyload"><br><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260617172815275-446890259.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>  填入API密钥后记得点击“检测”对该API进行验证是否有效。</p>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260617173102106-1242058953.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>　　随后便是配置MCP服务器，名称随意，类型选择“服务器发送事件（sse）”，URL的填写路径来自于Burp中的MCP服务配置“127.0.0.1:9876”<br>　　请求头必须要加，不加的话会报错</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">Origin=http://127.0.0.1:9876
Referer=http://127.0.0.1:9876
User-Agent=Cherry Studio</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260618102031911-1013531145.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260618103836589-1099495787.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　在Cherry中保存配置并运行，只要出现版本号则表示配置正确</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260618103941508-235049287.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　随后在Cherry页面中选择API对应的模型，以及刚配置好的MCP服务</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260618104130966-1547754450.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　　然后就可以开开心心的当一个半放手掌柜了</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3745953/202606/3745953-20260618104236327-737955618.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
